rules.label: misleading marketing
rules.text: An AI image or AI actor that gives a false impression of the product, or presents a synthetic person as a real customer, can be misleading marketing (markedsføringsloven § 7).

rules.label: EU AI Act
rules.text: EU AI Act labelling (Article 50) has applied in the EU since 2 August 2026 but is not yet Norwegian law (bill expected spring 2027). Campaigns that also reach EU audiences may already be caught: realistic AI people, places or products must be visibly labelled as AI.

pros: European company with a standard DPA; easiest to clear with a client
Polished, reliable output
cons: Corporate presenter look; weak for native-feeling social ads
Norwegian voices not confirmed in docs we could read — test first
